text:
maya: quick heads-up: i'm seeing a p99 latency regression on the attention path after the kernel-selector tweak. numbers below.

jonah: what cfg and workload? batch size / seq len?

maya: small batches (1-4), seq=128, kv cache cold (first-token after new convo). before (last week): p99 ~18ms. after deploy: p99 ~34ms.

maya: profile snippet from single-node repro run:
```
# before (kernel-select v1): flash_fused avg=10.3ms p99=18.4ms
# after  (kernel-select v2): flash_safe  avg=15.8ms p99=34.1ms
kernel-selector.log: selected=flash_safe reason=kv_cold_threshold(0.25) miss_rate=0.42
```

sarah: sounds like selector is falling back to the safe path on cold-kv. did you get a fallback stack trace / reason code?

maya: yep, trace shows selector evaluated kv_miss_ratio per shard and flipped to _safe when ratio > 0.3. the ratio calc changed in commit abc1234. link: https://git.redwood/commit/abc1234

jonah: ok that's my change — i tuned the threshold to avoid sporadic correctness issues. didn't expect it to trigger so much on our small-batch tail.

perf-bot: automated regression detector: p99 increased 89% for attention kernel on dedicated-small-batch perf suite. correlated commit: abc1234. snapshot: https://perf.redwood/reports/189045

maya: repro command i'm using:
```
./bench_repro --model=rw-small --batch=1 --seq=128 --kv-warm=false --runs=2000
```
raw median / p95 / p99 pasted above.

sarah: can you dump kernel selection debug env? e.g. KERNEL_SELECTOR_DEBUG=1. also add counters: kernel_launches, kernel_choice_path, kv_cache_hits.

maya: pushed logs to gist: https://gist.github.com/xxxx. sample lines:
```
[selector] shard=0 miss_ratio=0.48 selected=flash_safe reason=kv_cold_threshold
[exec] launch=flash_safe kernel_ms=16.2
```

ops-bot: @oncall please hold further runtime rollouts for the kernel-selector change. tagging rollback candidate.

jonah: i'll run a quick git bisect. starting between abc1200..abc1300. will report back.

sarah: quick mitigation: we could make selector check per-request prefix length before deciding fallback. also add a cheap micro-cached hint for first-token warm path.

maya: tried hack: export KERNEL_SELECTOR_ASSUME_KV_WARM=1 and reran bench -> p99 back to ~19ms. so selector flag flip restores perf.

jonah: bisect result: blame -> commit abc1234 (threshold change + miss_ratio calc). reverting threshold to 0.15 fixes p99. i'll put up PR that wires an override flag and adds unit tests for small-batch kv cold.

maya: awesome. let's add regression test in the perf-suite and a canary to avoid regen in dedicated pool.

jonah: PR 472 created: revert threshold + env flag + test. rolling to canary now.

perf-bot: canary metrics show p99 back down within 30 minutes. marking regressed -> fixed.

sarah: thanks all. follow-up: add more granular telemetry for early token path and document selector heuristics.

maya: leaving logs and repro in the thread, will update tickets.
